verified.exploit_entry_point: Java API: a Channel interceptor chain driven through EncryptInterceptor.sendMessage and messageReceived exactly as the project's own TestEncryptInterceptor does (send, capture the wire bytes, receive); every security and functional case uses that path.
sites: java/org/apache/catalina/tribes/group/interceptors/TcpPingInterceptor.java:149-160 and StaticMembershipInterceptor.java:200-235 (components that originate messages below the layer)
routes: T1: default configuration, IV bit and non-final ciphertext bit changed
T2: OFB and CFB configured explicitly, ciphertext bit changed
T4: a message-originating component placed below the encryption layer in the chain
T1/T2/T3/T4 coupled functional: project round-trips for every documented mode, a one-byte payload, and a chain that places the component above the encryption layer
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own TestEncryptInterceptor (16 cases, compiled from the pinned test sources) plus 2 functional chain cases and 7 hidden security cases; 25 cases per run on the pinned tree, the reference fix, the alternative fix, the hardening fix and every check patch.

traps.shape: the documented default configuration has no integrity protection: changing a bit in the transport IV or in a non-final ciphertext block changes the delivered plaintext while the padding still validates
where: java/org/apache/catalina/tribes/group/interceptors/EncryptInterceptor.java:505-517 (decrypt slices the IV and un-pads without an authentication check)
traps.realistic_because: the project's default configuration, and the advisory's own route
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the default is documented and the drop-on-failure behaviour looks like the protection

traps.shape: explicitly configured stream-like modes route to the same unauthenticated manager, so a default-only fix still accepts changed ciphertext in those modes
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: OFB and CFB are documented modes with their own project tests
traps.reason_to_dismiss: OFB/CFB are explicit opt-ins, not the default, so a default-only fix looks complete

traps.shape: a frame shorter than the IV reaches the IV constructor and throws an unchecked IllegalArgumentException instead of being discarded; the localized message for that case already exists but is unused
where: java/org/apache/catalina/tribes/group/interceptors/EncryptInterceptor.java:505-517 (no minimum length before the IV slice)
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code; the orphaned localized key shows the guard was intended
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a truncated frame looks like a robustness nicety, not an encryption gap

traps.shape: a cluster component that originates its own messages sends them to its next interceptor; when it sits below the encryption layer, its frames reach the transport unencrypted, and the startup guard checks only the opposite direction
where: java/org/apache/catalina/tribes/group/interceptors/EncryptInterceptor.java:86-97 (the startup guard walks the previous chain only)
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the components send through the chain below themselves; the documented chain order is the legitimate configuration the functional test keeps
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the bytes are fixed control markers, interceptor ordering is configuration, and the startup guard already covers the one ordering it knows about

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), full view (instruction, tree, tests, reference, trap list)

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: this surface is a message channel with no per-resource identity or authorization; the protected object is every message on the channel
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the protected operation has no normalising or adjusting step between the attacker's bytes and the authentication check
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or name parser is involved
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no authority or secret lookup that could fail open; the key is local configuration
